handoff: AC1–AC6 met and tested; review#1 F1 (resumable migrate) and F2 (logs/ + slice folder fixture) fixed. Unit 995/0, integration 526/0, typecheck clean. Minor only: commit failure after all moves leaves migrate unfinished; migrate ignores a live session; same-name file conflict throws each tick rather than mark_corrupt; nits.

findings.title: A failed commit after every entry has moved leaves the migration unfinished for good
findings.detail:
If git commit fails after state.json has moved (for example a pre-commit hook or signing failure), the resolver reads round 1 and decide never emits round.migrate again. The flat deletions stay staged outside the record pathspecs that later commits use, so the pushed branch keeps both the flat state.json and the round. Another clone then reads the flat record, which is stale. The implementer noted this as a residual. It is rare, and a failing commit also blocks every other boundary commit.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Treat staged flat deletions under runs/_story (or flat entries next to a round) as an unfinished migrate, or have the record commit's pathspec include runs/_story while any flat entry remains.

findings.title: round.migrate does not wait for a live session
findings.detail:
The guard checks the claim, rebase and merged state, but not a running session. norn done resolves runsDir before it writes. A receipt written in the milliseconds while act moves entries can land in a new flat receipts/ that was already listed and moved. It then gets committed flat and is stranded outside the round.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Skip migrate while the story has a live run, or re-list the flat folder until it is empty before moving state.json.

findings.title: A file in both places throws on every tick
findings.detail:
migrateEntry throws when a non-directory entry already exists in the round. After a partial stop, a norn done that reads flat numbers a new receipt from the flat receipts/ (0001…), which can collide with a receipt that already moved. round.migrate then fails the same way on every tick and nothing surfaces it as corrupt (S2).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Treat byte-identical files as already moved, and turn a real conflict into mark_corrupt rather than an endless throw.

findings.title: rmSync recursive/force on a folder that should be empty
findings.detail:
rmSync(join(cwd, from), { recursive: true, force: true }) silently deletes anything a concurrent writer put there after the child listing.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Use rmdirSync so a non-empty folder fails loudly.

findings.title: currentRound swallows every error
findings.detail:
The catch around readdirSync treats EACCES or ENOTDIR the same as ENOENT, so a broken rounds/ reads silently as a flat record.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Swallow only ENOENT (isErrno).

findings.title: Highest-round selection duplicated
findings.detail:
currentRound (store paths.ts) and remoteTarget (human.ts) each compute the highest-numbered round from folder names.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Extract a pure latestRound(names) into @norn/schema ids.ts.
